source_fixture.note: Same pinned fixture as the first handshake; every pixel color and derived height preserved exactly.

declared_limitation.name: T_JUNCTION_WALL_EDGES
declared_limitation.statement: Walls are full-edge quads; where three or more differing heights meet at a corner, vertical wall side edges form exact collinear T-junction overlaps. Every cell boundary is coordinate-coincident (proven: no cracks or holes), but the mesh is not strictly edge-manifold.
declared_limitation.consequence: Must be resolved (wall splitting per height interval) before collision, mesh processing, or LOD consume this geometry. Does not invalidate this milestone and does not affect rendering.
declared_limitation.proof_note: The edge-manifold formalization was tested, failed by exactly this overlap class, and was replaced by the full boundary-coincidence proof in tests/test_trixel32d_connected_surface.py.
